columns.name: in_email
columns.sql: customer_id IN (SELECT cm.customer_id FROM campaign_members cm JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = cm.campaign_id WHERE c.channel = 'email')

calls.result_text:
SQL:
SELECT
  customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
  ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
WHERE
  CAST(orders.customer_id IN (
    SELECT
      cm.customer_id
    FROM campaign_members AS cm
    JOIN campaigns AS c
      ON c.id = cm.campaign_id
    WHERE
      c.channel = 'email'
  ) AS BOOLEAN) = TRUE
GROUP BY
  customers__regions.name
ORDER BY
  "orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Revenue is the sum of order amounts, grouped by the region of the ordering customer. It counts only customers who belong to at least one campaign whose channel is 'email'. Each order is counted once, even if the customer is in more than one email campaign. All four regions had qualifying revenue, and no orders fell into an unknown region.
